subject: MPA: Shield anchors & evaluation sprint — SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.p@aureliabank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: sec-team@aureliabank.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPA kickoff: Shield anchors & evaluation sprint

Hi Vanessa / Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the performance numbers look promising. Before we structure the MPA, Aurelia needs a concise runbook for the security/compliance gates we expect during evaluation. Specifically the security team asked for a single-page view that ties: SOC 2 evidentiary asks, SIG/CAIQ items we need to answer, DPA redline points, and the retention windows (EU/US split) that will affect our data residency obligations.

Can Redwood provide:
- A proposed timeline in the MPA for when each gate is expected to be completed during a 6-week eval sprint.
- A short list of SOC 2 artifacts we can consume (report, controls mapping, evidence owners).
- Any temporary measures Redwood can put in place to shorten the SIG review (e.g., a SIG-lite export and contact for clarifications).
- Confirmation on retention windows and whether we can support a 30/90/365 retention carveout per dataset during the trial.

We'd like to lock the mutual action plan by EOD Thursday so procurement can start the SOW review. Attaching a template MPA would help.

Thanks,
Maya

--
Maya Patel
Head of Cloud Risk, Aurelia Bank
maya.p@aureliabank.com

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.p@aureliabank.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: Shield anchors & evaluation sprint

Maya — appreciate the clarity and the timeline ask. Attached is an MPA draft titled "MPA_Shield-Anchors_v1.xlsx" and a short "SOC2-ask-summary-Aurelia.pdf" that highlights the minimal evidence set we usually provide during an eval. High-level answers inline below and next steps at the bottom.

- Proposed timeline: 6-week sprint, split into three 2-week waves:
  * Week 1–2: Evidence intake + SIG-lite delivery + DPA redline resolution for trial environment.
  * Week 3–4: SOC 2 artifact review, environment staging for retention carveouts, and functional eval.
  * Week 5–6: Acceptance run + final evidence handoff and procurement signoff.

- SOC 2 artifacts:
  * Redwood provides: SOC 2 Type II (redacted), control mapping doc (control -> product feature), and a short evidence index with owners. See attached PDF.

- SIG/CAIQ:
  * We can provide a SIG-lite export (column-filtered workbook) within 48 hours of MPA sign. We'll also schedule a 30-min Q&A with our security engineer to go through the few open cells.

- DPA & redlines:
  * For the trial MPA we accept a limited set of DPA carveouts: 30-day log retention opt-in and a 90-day data blob retention for sandbox only. We'll document these in the SOW addendum so procurement has a single place to review.

- Retention windows:
  * US region: default 90 days for logs, 365 for production blobs; trial sandbox: configurable to 30/90.
  * EU region: we can pin to EU-only storage for the eval and support 90/365; any 30-day special retention needs a short data flow diagram (we'll draft one).

Next steps (proposed):
1) Maya: confirm if Aurelia accepts the 6-week anchor and sandbox carveouts by EOD Thu (27 May).
2) Redwood (Neha + Rafa): deliver SIG-lite export and updated MPA workbook by Mon 24 May.
3) Schedule security Q&A (30 min) for Tue 25 May — invite sec-team@aureliabank.com.
4) Procurement: we'll provide SOW addendum draft for the trial retention carveouts once MPA is signed.

Attachments:
- MPA_Shield-Anchors_v1.xlsx (MPA with milestones & owners)
- SOC2-ask-summary-Aurelia.pdf (2-pg summary of artifacts)
- SIG-lite-questionnaire.xlsx (trimmed SIG export)

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya.p@aureliabank.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, sec-team@aureliabank.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: Shield anchors & evaluation sprint

Thanks Vanessa — attached SIG-lite export is ready (see SIG-lite-questionnaire.xlsx). A few clarifications from Security/Infra so Aurelia's team has full context:

- SIG-lite scope: We trimmed the CAIQ to 48 high-priority rows the bank normally verifies during an eval (network segmentation, KMS integration, access reviews, incident response contacts). The full CAIQ is available on request but slows the intake.

- Evidence cadence: For SOC 2 artifacts, the evidence index points to snapshotable reports (read-only links) and a named owner. We can provide time-boxed evidence pulls — typically 48–72 hours after an ask.

- Retention technicals: To support a 30-day trial retention for sandbox, we'll:
  1) provision a sandbox tenant pinned to US-EAST with a 30-day lifecycle policy,
  2) implement a temporary retention flag in the config that expires at MPA end,
  3) provide a short data flow diagram for your review.

- Minor ask from our side: can Aurelia confirm whether audit logs from the trial need to be exported as part of procurement (some customers want an offline copy). If yes, we should list that as a deliverable in Week 6.

I'll be joining the Tue 25 May security Q&A and will bring the SIG owner.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: Shield anchors & evaluation sprint

Vanessa / Neha,

Thanks — procurement has reviewed the MPA_Shield-Anchors_v1 workbook and the trial DPA carveouts look acceptable for the pilot. We have two quick asks before issuing a short SOW addendum:
1) Please confirm the SIG-lite export will be delivered as a worksheet (not a PDF) so our reviewers can filter rows.
2) Provide a DocuSign-ready SOW addendum (one page) that lists the retention carveouts for the sandbox and the owner who will sign.

If those two items are available by EOD Wed (26 May) we can route for approval and aim to have signatures in 72 hours. Also confirm if Redwood will accept the Aurelia procurement PO flow (PO -> SOW addendum -> signature) — we typically need a finance contact for invoicing.

Procurement will also expect a single point of contact on Redwood's side for invoicing and contract questions (name, email).

Thanks,
Aurelia Procurement
procure@aureliabank.com
